confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Bogota price levels for July 2026; not checked against live menus, listings, or current rates. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely by neighborhood, season (mid-year school holidays, 20 July national holiday), and booking channel, so treat them as wide bands. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from their typical ratio to the beer anchor because direct recall of those prices is weak. The FX value is taken from search-result reporting of the RBA homepage (4.00 pm, 14 Oct 2026); the F11.1 table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Regional basis is general Colombian capital-city pricing with Latin American mid-cost capital context, from model knowledge. Beer is the reference point for the cocktail and wine ratios.
